vulnerability.name: USN-8263-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that ImageMagick incorrectly handled certain malformed image files in certain instances. If a user or automated system using ImageMagick were tricked into opening a specially crafted image, an attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of service or possibly execute code. These issues only affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS. (CVE-2018-15607, CVE-2018-18544, CVE-2019-13137, CVE-2019-13391, CVE-2019-13391)  It was discovered that ImageMagick incorrectly handled certain malformed image files in certain instances. If a user or automated system using ImageMagick were tricked into opening a specially crafted image, an attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of service or possibly execute code.
